takeaway: Inverse-vol sizing cuts drawdowns in stress (2008 S&P -37%->-21%), improves risk-adjusted ratios 15-50%. Caveat: some studies find no consistent edge across all markets; best with capped leverage + smoothed vol forecasts. -> idea vol-targeting.

Lopez de Prado: triple-barrier = volatility-scaled TP/SL/time labels; meta-labeling separates side (direction) from size, trained on the primary model's TP/FP to filter false positives and size bets. Event-sampling + triple-barrier + meta-labeling together improve strategy performance. -> ideas triple-barrier, meta-labeling.

30d relative-strength momentum persists ~7d in crypto; long-only top-quintile + trend overlay cut max DD 75%->45% and raised return vs BTC. High market-wide correlation is the main risk. arXiv:2512.08124 uses a NN to rank assets for long-only crypto — very close to our setup, worth a deep read. -> idea xsec-momentum.

topic: long-only crypto ranking (NN) — arXiv:2512.08124 full read
takeaway: NN ranks assets; features = last return, volatility, Sharpe, return-rank-correlation over 80d; retrain every 10d; rank^2 weighting concentrates on winners (best Sharpe 1.01, 64% ann.); weight-decay alpha=0.7 cuts churn. BUT max drawdown 77.4%, NO drawdown/vol control, and it 'drops at the end of the bearish market' — cross-sectional ranking ALONE does not survive bear markets. For us it is a SELECTION/SIZING refinement (prefer/size by relative rank among our entry candidates), not a bear defense; our trend filter + vol targeting + 25% mandate supply the defense the paper lacks. rank^2 sizing is worth an experiment on top of our gates.

Overlapping labels are non-IID -> double-count info -> overfitting + poor out-of-sample (exactly what our sealed 2026 just flagged for the new champion). Fix: instantaneous uniqueness of label i at t = 1/c_t (c_t=concurrent labels); average over the label's lifespan = its sample weight; down-weight redundant overlapping samples in the loss (BCE weight). Alt: sequential bootstrap / bagging with max_samples=avg uniqueness. Training-only change; A/B on/off via the loop.

topic: ensemble / bagging of NNs for variance reduction & generalization
takeaway: Bagging NNs = train N on seed/bootstrap-varied data, average predictions -> primarily reduces VARIANCE -> lower generalization error, less volatile returns, higher risk-return in financial time series. Directly targets our two open problems: year-to-year consistency (the law) and the sealed-2026 generalization gap that uniqueness did NOT close. Cost for us: N x train time per iteration (~40min -> ~120min at N=3). Implementation: ensemble param -> train N seed-varied nets, average sigmoid probs at infer.export before the band. A/B ensemble 1 vs 3.

topic: purged & embargoed cross-validation (Lopez de Prado ch.7)
takeaway: PURGE: drop train samples whose label-formation window overlaps the val range. EMBARGO: also drop a buffer of bars right after the val boundary. Prevents leakage that inflates validation and hurts out-of-sample. For us: our zigzag oracle labels are computed over the WHOLE series, so train bars near the split can 'know' post-split prices via pivots -> a subtle leak that could inflate our val-based band/selection and widen the sealed-2026 gap. Current pooled.py split already leaves a +window gap; a larger explicit embargo + purging boundary samples would tighten it. Complementary (does NOT touch the oracle).

topic: market breadth as an absolute risk-off regime filter (% of universe in uptrend)
takeaway: Percent of index members above a moving average is a canonical breadth/risk-off REGIME filter: >50% supports long exposure; PERSISTENT readings <~40% mean rallies are narrow and prone to failure (risk-off); extremes <20% = washed out. It fires ahead of broad market peaks and is used to rotate OUT of risk. Maps directly to our open problem: 2022 is a BROAD bear where the per-symbol trend filter still lets lone bounces in. Our causal __trend bit per coin is analogous to 'in an uptrend'; universe breadth = fraction of the 14 coins with trend=1. An ABSOLUTE gate (flatten the whole book when breadth < K) is a market-wide regime switch, DISTINCT from the rejected cross-sectional (relative) momentum gate which only reranks names and never de-risks. -> idea market-breadth-gate (original synthesis for our universe).
